This site documents **MapMet2**, the R-based single-cell analysis of
neuroblastoma **bone-marrow (BM)** samples imaged by IMC: normal control BM and
patient BM at diagnosis (DE), at the treatment timepoints T1 and T2 and at
relapse (REL). BM samples are cytospins, so the analysis is single-cell only
(no spatial analysis). MapMet2 is adapted from
[MapMetSC](https://github.com/TaschnerMandlGroup/MapMetSC), which analyses the
primary tumors, and uses data processed with
[MapMetIP](https://github.com/TaschnerMandlGroup/MapMetIP).

The steps below are run in order. To reproduce the whole pipeline, set the data
paths in `run_analysis.R` (in the repository root) and run it; each step reads
the object saved by the previous step. Shared colors are defined once in the
helper script `00_MapMet_color_code.R`, which every step sources.

## Pipeline

1. [Read single-cell and meta-data, and patient cohort overview](01_read_data.html)
2. [Quality control – part 1 (lost cells)](02_QC_1.html)
3. [Quality control – part 2 (segmentation artifacts)](03_QC_2.html)
4. [Cell phenotyping](04_phenotyping.html) — clustering, label transfer from
   MapMetSC, and the two-pass cluster annotation
5. Bone-marrow sample analysis
    - 5.1 Cellular communities (samples clustered on all cell types):
      [with the normal control BM](05.1_BM_cellularcomm_with_controls.html),
      [NB-patient samples only](05.1_BM_cellularcomm_without_controls.html)
    - [5.2 Differential abundance](05.2_BM_DA.html) — control vs patient BM,
      timepoints (paired by patient), relapse and MYCN status
6. Validation by correlation with reference scRNA-seq datasets
    - [6.1 Fetahu et al. (neuroblastoma bone marrow)](06.1_correlation_Fetahu.html)
    - [6.2 Lee et al. (healthy bone marrow)](06.2_correlation_Lee.html)
7. [Region and marker images](07_generate_images.html)
